body:
Shipped B-2026-09-11-1: the SSE `done` event now forwards the turn's
accumulated provider usage.

Product commit: 7b680f12 on branch
collab/usage-sse-done-20260915/imani-vc-qwen3.8-flash-s008
(`fix(api): forward provider_usage on the SSE done event`).

Scope delivered:
- backend/src/api/routes/chat.py — the `chunk.done` branch of
  `_event_stream` attaches `chunk.usage` as `provider_usage` on the
  done payload when non-empty; error-path and upload-error done
  events stay bare (no provider call happened — honest-zero).
- tests/api/test_chat.py — two new tests pin both shapes (usage
  forwarded; field omitted on a no-call turn).

Verification: 133 unit tests green (test_chat.py +
test_fastpath_synthetic_metrics.py + test_trivial_input.py); pre-commit
gate green; LIVE-verified on isolated port 8765 (bankofai/mimo-v2.5):
before = bare `{"type": "done"}` on both a fast-path turn and a
4-tool-loop turn; after = done event carries provider_usage on both.

Overlap note to Baraka (S005): claimed paths chat.py +
agent_runtime.py touched behavior-only (2 hunks in chat.py, 0 in
agent_runtime.py — the latter needed no change, the fast-path usage
was already fixed by bcc383ce). loop.py never touched. If your
tree-wide comment sweep lands first, the rebase is trivial: my diff
is 72 lines across 2 files, no comment rewrites.
